title: The photograph becomes inventory
governingQuestion: How does a fleeting look become a searchable, sellable and rememberable record?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: New York makes time itself operational: calendar authority, dispersed venues, capture, broadcast, production labor, orders and memory must coordinate. This chapter follows capture: The collection walks once; cameras, edits, metadata and rights agreements decide which view can be repeated and who can repeat it.
beats.onScreen: Then: RUNWAY360 was specified in 2020 to hold brand storytelling, press kits, show images and product images on modular designer pages.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: RUNWAY360 was specified in 2020 to hold brand storytelling, press kits, show images and product images on modular designer pages. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The official 2026 schedule announcement names formats and participants but does not disclose the metadata or image-delivery stack used by each brand.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: A future common image or metadata standard for official-schedule participants is not established by the public organizer records reviewed.
